database_specific.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookup (Log4Shell) is not present in any General Bots product

statements.impact_statement: General Bots Server, the Suite/botui and the desktop client are Rust and TypeScript builds. The appliance inventory (SPDX SBOM generated by scripts/security/../syft in the security workflow) contains no Java runtime and no log4j-core package, in any edition: SaaS, private cloud or desktop-local. There is therefore no code path in which an attacker-supplied ${jndi:...} string could reach a Log4j lookup. Precise scope: botserver >= 1.0.0 (pkg:generic/generalbots/botserver); botui >= 1.0.0 (pkg:generic/generalbots/botui); botapp (desktop client) >= 1.0.0 (pkg:generic/generalbots/botapp).

vulnerability.description: CVE-2021-44228 affects Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0. No General Bots product ships Java or Log4j2, so the vulnerable component is not present in any supported configuration.
vulnerability.name: CVE-2021-44228
